docs.summary: Renders 3D previews of assets (models, materials, meshes) to a RenderTexture. Creates an isolated Scene with camera + light for clean rendering. Supports orbit camera for interactive previews.
Whether to draw a grid plane in the preview.

Draws as an overlay onto a target cleared to transparent instead of over the skybox, so only the subject has alpha. Graphite views clear opaque, so the target is zeroed before each render. Colour comes out premultiplied.

Gets the width of the preview render target in pixels.
Gets the height of the preview render target in pixels.
Creates a new PreviewRenderer with the given render target dimensions. Sets up an isolated Scene with a camera and directional light.

docs.summary: Poses the subject at a point through a clip, from 0 at its first frame to 1 at its last. Sampling rather than playing is what makes the preview scrub: any time is one call, in any order, and it works outside play mode where nothing is ticking.
